name: @w6w-apps/coingecko
description: Crypto prices, market data, charts, search, trending and exchange data from CoinGecko.

w6w.longDescription:
CoinGecko is the independent crypto data aggregator, and this app puts its market data into a workflow: current prices for any number of coins in any number of currencies, ranked market listings with 24-hour change and market cap, full coin profiles, historical snapshots, price/market-cap/volume charts and OHLC candles, plus search, trending, global market statistics, exchanges and coin categories.

It works with either CoinGecko plan. A Demo key (free) is served from api.coingecko.com and a Pro-family key (Basic, Analyst, Lite, Pro, Enterprise) from pro-api.coingecko.com; the two are separate auth methods because the host and the header name both differ and a key sent to the wrong host is refused. Every action calls the same v3 paths on either host, so a workflow is portable between plans.

Coverage is the read-only core of the v3 API: simple price, coin lists and market data, coin detail, history and charts, search, trending, global data, exchanges and categories. On-chain (GeckoTerminal), NFT, derivatives, treasury and RWA endpoints are not covered yet.
